sections.template: {{company||We}} use cookies and similar tracking technologies on this website. Cookies are small text files placed on your device to help the site function, remember your preferences, analyse traffic and improve your experience.

sections.title: Types of cookies we use
items: Essential cookies: required for the website to operate and to maintain security. These cookies do not collect personal information.
Preference cookies: remember your settings and choices to improve your experience.
Analytics cookies: help us understand how visitors interact with the website so that we can improve it. Where analytics data may identify you, we rely on an appropriate lawful basis under POPIA.
Third-party cookies: set by approved service providers (for example, analytics or advertising partners) and governed by their own privacy notices.

sections.template: You can manage or disable cookies through your browser settings. Please note that restricting essential cookies may affect the functionality of the website. By continuing to use this website, you consent to the use of cookies in accordance with this notice.

sections.template: This privacy policy explains how {{company||we}} collects, uses, protects and shares personal information. By using our website or providing your personal information to us, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this policy.

sections.title: Identity of the responsible party
sections.template: {{company||We}} are the responsible party for the processing of personal information collected through this website and our related services. Our contact details are:

sections.title: What personal information we collect
sections.template: "Personal information" has the meaning ascribed to it in POPIA. We may collect:

items: Directly from you: name, contact details, identity or company registration number, billing and payment information, and any other information you provide when you register, request a quote, place an order, subscribe to newsletters or contact us.

Automatically: IP address, browser type and version, device information, operating system, pages viewed, time spent on the site, referring URLs and other analytics data collected via cookies and similar technologies.

sections.title: Purpose of processing
sections.template: We process personal information only for lawful and specified purposes, including to:

items: provide our products and services;
process orders, payments and deliveries;
communicate with you, including service-related messages;
carry out direct marketing where permitted and with an opportunity to opt out;
improve our website, services and customer experience;
comply with legal and regulatory obligations; and
protect our rights, property and legitimate interests.

sections.title: Legal basis for processing
sections.template: We process personal information only where a lawful basis exists, such as:

items: Consent: where you have given express consent, for example to receive marketing communications.
Contract: where processing is necessary to perform a contract with you or to take steps at your request before entering into a contract.
Legal obligation: where we are required to process information by law.
Legitimate interest: where processing is necessary for our legitimate business interests, provided your rights and interests do not override those interests.

sections.title: Direct marketing and opt-out
sections.template: We may use your personal information to send you promotional communications by email, SMS or other channels, but only where permitted by POPIA. You may opt out of direct marketing at any time by contacting us at {{officer_email||{{email}}}} or using the unsubscribe link in any marketing message.

sections.title: Cookies and device data
sections.template: We use cookies and similar technologies to collect device and usage data. For more information, please see our cookie notice.

sections.title: Sharing with third parties
sections.template: We do not sell personal information. We may share personal information with trusted third parties who assist us in operating our business, such as payment processors, delivery partners, IT service providers, marketing service providers, legal advisers and auditors. These third parties are required to maintain appropriate confidentiality and security safeguards.

sections.title: Transborder flows
sections.template: Personal information may be transferred to and processed in countries outside South Africa. Where this occurs, we will take reasonable steps to ensure that the recipient provides an adequate level of protection for the personal information, or that the transfer is otherwise lawful under POPIA.

sections.title: Data subject rights
sections.template: Under POPIA and PAIA, you have the right to:

items: request access to your personal information;
request correction or deletion of inaccurate or irrelevant personal information;
object to the processing of your personal information;
lodge a complaint with the Information Regulator; and
withdraw consent where processing is based on consent.

sections.template: To exercise your rights, please contact us at {{officer_email||{{email}}}}. We may require proof of identity before processing your request.

sections.title: Retention
sections.template: We retain personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes for which it was collected, to comply with legal obligations, to resolve disputes and to enforce our agreements.

sections.title: Security
sections.template: We implement appropriate technical and organisational security measures to safeguard personal information against loss, unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration or destruction. No internet-based system can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

sections.title: Information Officer
sections.template: {{company||We}} have appointed an Information Officer who is responsible for POPIA compliance and for handling access-to-information requests. Contact details are available on request at {{officer_email||{{email}}}}.

sections.title: Complaints to the Information Regulator
sections.template: If you believe we have infringed your privacy rights, you may contact the Information Regulator of South Africa. Contact details are available at www.justice.gov.za/inforeg/contact.html.

sections.title: Children's privacy
sections.template: Our services are not directed to children under the age of 18, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children without appropriate consent.

sections.title: Changes to this privacy policy
sections.template: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. The current version will be published on our website with the date of the latest revision. Continued use of the website after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.

sections.template: This manual is published in terms of section 51 of the Promotion of Access to Information Act 2 of 2000 (PAIA), read with section 32 of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa, 1996, and the Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013 (POPIA).

sections.title: Right of access
sections.template: PAIA gives every person a right of access to records held by a public or private body, subject to the grounds for refusal set out in PAIA.

sections.title: Information Officer
sections.template: The Information Officer is responsible for dealing with access-to-information requests:

sections.title: Records held
sections.template: {{company||We}} hold records relating to, but not necessarily limited to:

items: company records and statutory filings;
customer, supplier and client information;
financial, accounting and tax records;
personnel and human-resources records;
contracts and agreements;
information technology and system records; and
marketing and communication records.

sections.title: Request procedure and form
sections.template: Requests for access to records must be made on the prescribed PAIA application form and submitted to the Information Officer. The request must provide sufficient detail to identify the record requested and the requester's preferred form of access.

sections.title: Fees
sections.template: A request fee and further access fees may be payable as prescribed by law. The Information Officer will inform you of any applicable fees before processing your request.

sections.title: Decision period
sections.template: The Information Officer will notify you of the decision on your request within the period prescribed by PAIA, normally 30 days, unless an extension applies.

sections.title: Grounds for refusal
sections.template: Access to certain records may be refused in terms of PAIA, including records that are protected by legal privilege, contain confidential commercial information, include third-party personal information, or whose disclosure could reasonably be expected to endanger the life or physical safety of an individual or prejudice law enforcement or national security.

sections.title: Complaint to the Information Regulator
sections.template: If you are dissatisfied with the decision on your request or the manner in which it was handled, you may lodge a complaint with the Information Regulator in terms of PAIA.

sections.template: At {{company||we}} want you to be satisfied with your purchase. This returns and refunds policy sets out your rights and our procedures.

sections.title: CPA-implied warranty

sections.template: If you purchased goods as a result of direct marketing, you have the right to cancel the transaction within five business days after the date of purchase or delivery, whichever is later, for any reason. You will receive a full refund within the period prescribed by law.

sections.template: Subject to the exclusions below, you may return goods within {{returnwindow}} days of delivery, provided the goods are unused, undamaged and in their original packaging with all tags and accessories.

sections.title: Condition of returned goods
sections.template: Returned goods must be in original condition. We reserve the right to refuse a refund or exchange if the goods show signs of use, damage or wear that is not due to a defect, or if original packaging, accessories or documentation are missing.

sections.title: Refund method
sections.template: Refunds will be processed using the original payment method or by electronic funds transfer, unless otherwise agreed. Refund processing times may vary depending on your payment provider.

sections.title: Exclusions

items: perishable goods;
personalised or custom-made goods;
goods that are intimate or hygienic in nature;
